manual.title: 📖 User Guide & Practice Manual
manual.searchPlaceholder: Search manual (e.g. hold, lockout, quick keys...)
manual.practice1Title: ① Lock and listen to active signal (Channel Hold)
manual.practice1Step1: When you hear a transmission you want to follow, click ⏸ Hold.
manual.practice1Step2: The scanner locks to that frequency so you won't miss replies and subsequent messages.
manual.practice1Step3: When finished, click ▶ Scan to resume scanning.
manual.practice2Title: ② Skip noise or unwanted chatter (Temporary Lockout: T-L/O)
manual.practice2Step1: When stopped on noise or unwanted channel, click L/O.
manual.practice2Step2: It immediately skips to next channel and adds to the Web T-L/O list automatically.
manual.practice2Step3: Temporary lockout stays in effect until scanner power cycle or Unlock All.
manual.practice3Title: ③ Restore temporarily locked out channels (T-L/O Unlock All)
manual.practice3Step1: Method A: Hold the L/O button for ~0.65s.
manual.practice3Step2: Method B: Click the 🔓 Unlock All button on the T-L/O panel.
manual.practice3Step3: Method C: Click ✕ next to individual channels in the T-L/O list.
manual.practice4Title: ④ Focus scanning on a single jurisdiction/agency (System Hold)
manual.practice4Step1: While receiving or holding a channel in target system, long-press ⏸ Hold for ~0.65s.
manual.practice4Step2: System Hold indicator appears; scanner cycles only through the selected system.
manual.practice4Step3: Long-press ⏸ Hold again or click ▶ Scan to release.
manual.practice5Title: ⑤ Tune directly to a specific frequency (Direct Tune)
manual.practice5Step1: Click ⏸ Hold to enter hold mode.
manual.practice5Step3: Press E or ⏸ Hold to jump directly to that frequency.
manual.practice6Title: ⑥ Instant one-touch memory save (Quick Store)
manual.practice6Step1: Tune or hold the desired frequency found during search or direct tune.
manual.practice6Step3: Frequency is immediately stored into the scanner's 'Quick Store' group.
manual.practice7Title: ⑦ Toggle channel groups instantly (Group Quick Keys)
manual.practice7Step2: Immediately press numpad digit 1 - 9 to toggle corresponding group.
manual.practice7Step3: Note: Pressing digits without FUNC toggles System Quick Keys.
manual.practice8Title: ⑧ Navigate hardware configuration menu (Menu Navigation)
manual.practice8Step1: Click MENU to display settings on Virtual LCD.
manual.practice8Step2: Use ▲ / ▼ (or keyboard ↑ / ↓) to navigate items.
manual.practice8Step3: Press E (or Enter) to select, MENU or . (NO) to go back.

manual.overviewTitle: 📡 Screen layout and what each panel does
manual.overviewDisplayBody: Shows the frequency being received, system, department, channel, RSSI signal strength and mode in real time. Switch to "Virtual LCD" for a faithful copy of the radio's own 3/4-line text and icons.
manual.overviewAudioBody: Streams the scanner's received audio to the browser in real time with low latency (100–300 ms).
manual.overviewControlBody: Scan control, hardware VOL/SQ sliders, the radio's keypad, temporary lockout (T-L/O) management and auto-recording settings.
manual.overviewLogBody: Search and CSV-export the history of received transmissions, and instantly play or waveform-seek the auto-recorded MP3 files.
